p1.title: SkyCourt Enterprise WMS
p1.description: Production warehouse and operations suite for an industrial fabrication company: two-operator dispatch verification, a database-enforced immutable movement ledger, exact-decimal reconciliation, and an Arabic-first field supervisor app on a shared domain kernel.

p2.title: Queen Hive Agent Orchestrator
p2.description: A visual platform that chains AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, AGY) into pipelines, streams every run live, and automatically loops failed work back through repair until verification passes.

p3.title: Texture Extractor for Blender
p3.description: A commercial Blender extension that turns perspective photos into clean textures and UV-mapped meshes fully offline, with on-device SAM 2.1 segmentation, homography rectification and GPU-drawn interactive tools.

p4.title: O2mation Omnichannel AI Support
p4.description: Multi-tenant support SaaS: Gemini bots answer on Telegram and Meta channels grounded in company documents, humans take over live through a WebSocket queue, and usage is metered with race-safe Postgres credits.
